newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies close mixed, stg sets contract high.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies close mixed, stg sets contract high.

text.p: Oct 25 - IMM currency futures closed mixed, with Dec sterling setting a contract high at $1.6080 on heavy speculative and mutual fund buying, traders said. Dec yen set a contract low at $0.008873. Dec marks ended lower, despite rallying to weekly highs on Buba Tietmeyer's comments that there was no need for further rate cut in foreseeable future. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
